messages:
Priya: Quick sync — we need to align on who owns routing decision rights vs. who owns customer-specific exceptions for the long-term platform roadmap. Goal: surface launch criteria and customer asks we can commit to for H2.
Marcus: +1. Can we map to current policy primitives (region, model tier, capacity tier)?
Leila: I'd propose three buckets: global policy, customer override (entitlement), and emergency evacuation. Each has different SLA/ops burden.
Omar: ops note — customer override => dedicated capacity request or soft-quarantine? both have infra implications.
Chen: Example asks from Merchant X: route EU traffic to EU-only models and failover to a lower-cost model in minutes during overload. They want data residency + predictable latency.
Ana (Sales): Merchant X is willing to sign for Dedicated if we give 99.9% latency SLO and config controls. Need clear acceptance criteria.
Priya: Draft launch criteria (quick):
```
- Defined policy primitives and owner (product/arch)
- Migration story for existing customers
- Cost model for overrides and Dedicated
- Test harness for failovers + regression tests
- Ops runbook & SLOs
```
Marcus: Add: compatibility matrix for model variants and quantization levels.
Leila: Prioritization suggestion: 1) Data-residency lanes for regulated customers, 2) Entitlement APIs for overrides, 3) Emergency evacuation playbook.
Omar: Quick ask: estimate infra delta for per-tenant routing (~ 4-8% on baseline), dedicated pools add 20-30% capacity overhead.
Chen: For Merchant X we'll need per-tenant KV cache isolation — otherwise cache bleed affects latency/cost.
Priya: Action items: @Marcus to own policy DSL, @Leila to draft customer entitlement API, @Omar to scope infra delta, @Ana to capture binding customer asks and contract language by EOW.
Marcus: I'll prototype DSL sketch by Wed, will include operator and vendor-mode toggles.
Leila: I'll draft API surface — include rate limits, model pins, region pins. Also will start an eval plan.
Omar: I'll get a top-level capacity estimate and run a quick simulation next sprint.
Ana (Sales): I'll update Merchant X and ask for formal acceptance criteria.
SRE-bot: Deploy note: routing-dsl-prototype branch created by Marcus.
Priya: Thanks all. Next sync Friday 10am to review prototypes and final launch checklist. :thumbsup:
